rules.rule: When an object must be cleaned and placed: search the object's current location first, clean it with the sinkbasin, then move it to the target.
rules.example: take plate 2 from countertop 3, go to sinkbasin 1, clean plate 2 with sinkbasin 1, go to shelf 1, move plate 2 to shelf 1
rules.validation: confirmed: object was found on countertop 1, cleaned at sinkbasin 1, then moved to sidetable 1 | confirmed: plate was on countertop 3, cleaned at sinkbasin 1, then moved to shelf 1 | confirmed: towel was on towelholder 1, cleaned at sinkbasin 1, but agent failed to place it in toilet 1 due to repeated attempts on sinkbasin 1
